title: Kim and the Ten Kids
lines: Ten kids sit in the sun.
Kim gets pegs and a big net.
The kids dig and set up the pegs.
But a peg is bad and did not fit.
Kim gets a tin pin and taps it in.
The pin fits, and the net is up!
Ten kids sit in it. It is a den!
"Kim did it," said a kid, and Kim nods.

questions.ask: What did Kim get to make the den?
questions.listenFor: Pegs and a big net. Line two says it. Let your child reread rather than telling them.

questions.ask: What did Kim use when the peg did not fit?
questions.listenFor: A tin pin. Line five says it. One word is plenty here.

questions.ask: What would you make with pegs and a net? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is a good answer. You are listening for the reason behind it, not the thing itself.
